purpose: Teach: どん底/城壁/順応/蒸発/牽制/発着/老齢/海戦

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、被害者ご家族がどん底の心境であることを警察、配慮されてますね
lines.en: I notice the police are being considerate of how devastated the victim's family must be.
lines.style: Quiet admiration. Measured pace. Slight pause before 'the police'—acknowledging the careful observation. Thoughtful, not performative. The tone of someone noticing something good and saying it plainly.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、城壁のような防護網を地域に張ります
lines.en: The police are putting a protective network in place across the community.
lines.style: Clear, official cadence without stiffness. Grounded confidence. Each phrase lands with measured weight. Matter-of-fact—stating what needs doing, not dramatizing it.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、容疑者の社会順応状況を警察、確認されますね
lines.en: I see the police are also checking into the suspect's ability to function in society.
lines.style: Observant, slightly probing tone. Moderate pace with a small lift at the end—genuine curiosity, not interrogation. Respectful but searching for confirmation.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、突然の蒸発事件にも全力で対応します
lines.en: The police are responding with full force even to cases involving sudden disappearances.
lines.style: Measured, professional delivery. Slight emphasis on 'full force'—indicating commitment without fanfare. Steady eye contact level. The tone of someone stating institutional resolve.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、警察、相手組織を牽制する措置も取られましたね
lines.en: It seems the police have also taken steps to check any rival organizations involved.
lines.style: Careful, analytical tone. Deliberate pacing. The word 'steps' lands with slight weight—acknowledging serious preventive action. Respectful observation, not accusation.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、空港での発着便管理にも協力します
lines.en: The police are coordinating with airport authorities on all arrivals and departures.
lines.style: Professional, procedural. Crisp delivery on 'coordinating' and 'arrivals and departures.' No hesitation. The voice of institutional competence laying out facts.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、老齢の被害者への配慮を警察、なさってますね
lines.en: I can see the police are taking care to consider the victim's age in all of this.
lines.style: Gentle recognition. Slower pace on 'age'—letting it carry its own weight. Quiet respect underneath. The tone of noticing something humane and acknowledging it without sentimentality.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、海戦の遺物に関する不法売買も捜査します
lines.en: The police are also investigating the illegal trade in artifacts from that maritime incident.
lines.style: Firm, serious. Crisp attack on 'illegal trade.' Professional boundaries clear. Each element—maritime, artifacts, investigation—stated with equal weight. No softening, no dramatization.
